title: A cleaner Birdcar homepage
question: Same palette, copy and offer. Which composition feels closest? You can choose one or describe a combination.

options.label: A clear next step
options.thesis: A calm introduction with the free assessment immediately in view.
options.viewport: Personal explanation on the left, a compact mustard assessment panel on the right, real work below.
options.risk: The most offer-led of the three; less room for decorative personality.

options.label: Straight to the point
options.thesis: The clearest, most restrained expression of the existing message.
options.viewport: Broad headline and ordered prose, followed by a simple assessment strip and the Craft & Communicate story.
options.risk: The quietest option; personality comes mainly from your voice, logo and color.

options.label: A little character
options.thesis: Clear service information with one small, playful piece of work-related art.
options.viewport: A clear introduction and booking button with a small work illustration alongside; the approach becomes easy to scan.
options.risk: Closest to PostHog’s whimsy; the illustration needs restraint to keep the page feeling grown-up.
